superset_strategy_use.explanation: Topology, terminal-monad, q79/theta, Qa/SU3, HYM, and dynamic-overlap paths are combined only to lock the selected source/operator boundary. The measured parameter replay then proceeds as a straight SM-standard downstream computation.
superset_strategy_use.locked_target: static SM source/interface boundary plus measured-slot policy

theorem.name: SMEquivalenceReferenceSourceRegistryTheorem
theorem.statement: The measured replay manifest has a versioned reference-source registry sufficient to fill SM-equivalence values in the next artifact. The registry authorizes PDG, NIST/CODATA, and NuFIT sources for their respective slots, while forbidding uncited, inverse-fit, or residual-selected values.
